issues.reason: "Where a THING is" states the head is the event-vs-entity distinction and that `Location` never attaches to an entity, so `(Location sk_group_1 japan)` is ill-typed on a minted group individual; the containment preposition "in" makes `(LocatedIn sk_group_1 japan)` the licensed head.

new_gaps: a group whose members are event-denoting nouns (earthquakes) has no stated positioning route: `LocatedIn` is specified for things and `Location` for eventualities, and the instruction set does not say which side a group of eventualities falls on
repair_summary: Replaced the ill-typed event oblique `(Location sk_group_1 japan)` with the static containment head `(LocatedIn sk_group_1 japan)`; all other atoms, symbols and order unchanged.
notes: The vague-count route is correct — "a lot of" is a listed `CardinalityPhrase` phrase and here counts things rather than setting generic strength, so no number is invented.
